label: Fires at D2 when a2 reaches S2, stronger after a reward, fading over the episode.
explanation: Silent at D1 and GO. At D2 it is active only when the just-made choice was a2 and the reached state is S2 (common a2 transition, observed at D2). Within those steps its magnitude rises when the previous trial was rewarded (shown at this trial D1), and its amplitude falls steadily with episode time beyond what the phase x decile baseline captures (the baseline averages over all D2 steps, so the conjunction with ep_dec matters). The free fit adds belief_lo (stronger when the observer believes S2 is good), whether the previous choice was also a2 (weaker on the first a2 after a switch from a1), reward two trials back and belief_cover; together these raise dev R^2 from 0.55 to 0.59. All terms are observed-only.

issues: Most claims check out on test. The recorded short form scores 0.521 R^2 beyond timing (weights: indicator +0.89, x prev_reward +0.67, x ep_dec -0.15), which is above the 'all observed' additive reference (0.50). Both modifiers matter: dropping ep_dec gives 0.374 and dropping prev_reward gives 0.418. The profile confirms the feature is exactly zero at D1 and GO, and that at D2 the residual is +0.53 for the a2->S2 cell and about -0.34 for every other choice x state cell.

Large systematic error not covered by the label or the short form: at D2 it over-predicts when the previous trial was an a1 trial. Errors by previous trial: a1 S2 r -0.49, a1 S1 u -0.32, a1 S1 r -0.27, a1 S2 u -0.26, plus a2 S1 r -0.35. In other words, the first a2->S2 after an a1 trial is much weaker than predicted. The worst case is after a1 S2 r, where prev_reward=1 wrongly adds +0.67. The free fit with prev_action==2 and belief_lo still leaves -0.39 after a1 S2 r. The earlier firing-based label already noted this ('weaker on the first a2 after switching'), but the recorded label leaves it out.

'Stronger after a reward' overstates things. The reward boost depends on the previous trial: the residual after a2 S2 r is +0.52 but after a2 S1 r it is only +0.03, and a2 S1 u (+0.17) is higher than a2 S1 r. So it behaves more like evidence that S2 is good from a2 trials than like a generic previous reward. Observed-only alternatives that fit within three short-form terms score lower on test: last_is('a2 S2 r') 0.499, belief_lo 0.500, prev_action==2 0.423, adding a last_is('a1 S2 r') correction 0.432. So no better short form was found.

Minor fit artifact: misses shows a constant +0.08 error at D1 and GO, where the feature is silent. The fitted intercept pushes predictions there to -0.08. This is harmless but it is not an error in the component.
